figurative_meaning_bn: দৃঢ়; বিচ্যুত করা যায় না এমন
figurative_meaning_en: Firm; unshakeable or deeply rooted and cannot be displaced
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই গ্রামের ঐতিহ্য বদ্ধমূল হয়ে আছে।
example_sentences_in_english: His political views are completely deep-rooted.
The traditions of this village are firmly ingrained.
note: Often used to describe entrenched ideas or customs in Bengali literature and conversation.
